items.summary: In this interview from Money20/20 USA, Prashant Fuloria, CEO of Fundbox, discusses embedded finance, small business lending, capital access, and the evolving role of fintech in supporting entrepreneurs. JD Durkin spoke with Fuloria about embedded lending, automation, fintech partnerships, cash flow management, and opportunities to improve financial access for small businesses. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on how embedded financial services are transforming the way business owners access capital. The interview also explores Fundbox's approach to integrating lending solutions directly into platforms that businesses already use daily. Another major theme is the importance of cash flow and working capital management for small business success. The conversation further examines partnerships with QuickBooks (NASDAQ: INTU), Stripe, SoFi Technologies (NASDAQ: SOFI), and other financial and software providers. The interview also highlights how embedded lending can reduce friction and streamline access to financing at critical moments within business workflows. Another key topic is technology-driven underwriting and the use of automation to evaluate and serve business customers more efficiently. The discussion explores how financial institutions and fintech providers can better address the needs of underserved small businesses. Additionally, Fuloria discusses trust, transparency, and responsible lending practices within modern digital financial services. The conversation further examines the operational challenges traditional lenders face when serving smaller businesses seeking modest amounts of capital.
